what: The hero is split into three vertical columns, each stacking several photos, and every layer is delayed 5 seconds so a full cycle takes 30 seconds (6 layers) — the top layer stays 5.1 seconds, then over 2.1 seconds its bottom edge rolls up and vanishes (clip-path, ease), while the inner photo drifts -15% linearly over 7.2 seconds and fades in the last .9 seconds. Columns lag .15 seconds each so the curtain passes like a wave from the left. On phones the columns become horizontal rows and clear to the left

options.each: Length of one slide (seconds), default 5 — peel and push phases scale up and down with it using the original ratios (17·24·32·79·80%). Three or more slides
options.dir: Side the panel lifts away on wide screens: up (default)·left
options.narrow: Side that retracts on narrow screens, default left
options.--fx-cols: Number of cells (via style, CSS grid), default 3

note: The original delays three CSS keyframes (slideMask·slideMove·slideFade) per section with animation-delay — the cell delay (.15s) applies only to sections and photos, not to the inner slide (same as the original). With reduced motion on, only the first section shows
